h1: Know when the next nap is coming.
lede: HeyNap plans your baby's naps and bedtime from their age and the sleep you log. It reminds you before the next nap, so you can start winding down in time.
a1: It starts from what is typical for your baby's age: how long they can stay awake, how many naps they take and how long. As you log naps and bedtimes, the plan follows your baby's own rhythm, and it updates through the day from what you log.
a2: From birth to two years. Under two months, babies don't keep a schedule yet, so the plan is only a guide: follow your baby's sleepy cues.
a3: Logging sleep, feeds, nappies, health and growth is free. The plan, nap predictions, reminders, your stats and most sounds are part of a subscription.
a4: No. HeyNap gives general guidance on when your baby may be ready to sleep. It doesn't diagnose anything. If you're worried about your baby's sleep or health, talk to your GP or child health nurse.
get_text: Tell it your baby's age and usual wake-up time, and it shows you today's plan.
note: Free to download. Logging is free; the plan, reminders and stats need a subscription.
